changeSet.author: sDooley
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] default(newid()) NOT NULL, [Type] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Url] [nvarchar](2000) NOT NULL, [SortIndex] int NOT NULL default(0) CONSTRAINT [PK_HelpResource] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[HelpResource]') AND name = 'Type' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource] DROP COLUMN [Type] END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'isEditable') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource] ADD [isEditable] [bit] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HelpResource_isEditable DEFAULT 1 WITH VALUES end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'visibilty') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource] ADD [visibilty] [int] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HelpResource_visibilty DEFAULT 1 WITH VALUES end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'order') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource] ADD [order] [int] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HelpResource_order DEFAULT 1000 WITH VALUES end
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'isSystem') begin ALTER TABLE [dbo].[HelpResource] ADD [isSystem] [bit] NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_HelpResource_isSystem DEFAULT 0 WITH VALUES end
if exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'HelpResource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'visibilty') BEGIN EXEC sp_rename 'dbo.HelpResource.visibilty', 'visibility', 'COLUMN'; END
